[[File:Luke-Allies.jpg|thumb|left|180px|Skywalker at the time of his alliance with the Sith]]
On board his ship, Luke received an interesting offer. [[Gavar Khai]], the father of Vestara informed him that Abeloth was driving their Sith apprentices mad as well. Due to the stroke of madness infesting young Jedi, Luke reluctantly formed an unprecedented alliance with the Lost Tribe of Sith. Unbeknown to him, however, this had been a trick by the Sith. When Gavar was allowed to speak with his daughter, they secretly plotted to lure Ben to the dark side or use him as a source of information until he was no longer useful. The Skywalkers recorded their conversation, but the Sith were speaking in an [[Keshiri language|unknown]] language, so Luke sent the recording to C-3PO for translation.<ref name="Allies" />

Luke called in a favor from Lando to bring in the ''[[Rockhound]]'' to help navigate the Maw. While waiting for Lando in orbit of [[Klatooine/Legends|Klatooine]], Luke sent Ben, Vestara and Stadd to gather some supplies. However, Stadd also succumbed to the enigmatic madness and nearly desecrated the [[Fountain of Ancients]]. Only Ben and Vestara's intervention stopped him from doing so before they were detained by the [[Klatooinian/Legends|Klatooinian]] authorities. Luke and Gavar went to free their offspring and had Stadd released into their custody, as the Klatooinians lacked the proper facilities to hold him. Once they got Stadd back on the ''Shadow'', Luke warned his son that Vestara was not to be trusted, which Ben did not believe.<ref name="Allies" />

Threepio presented a rough translation to Luke, confirming his suspicions that the Sith were lying to him and that Vestara was intentionally manipulating his son. He then showed the recording to Ben, which left him feeling humiliated but still attracted to Vestara, believing that he could bring her to the light side.<ref name="Allies" />

Along with the Sith flotilla and Lando, the Skywalkers journeyed into the Maw, only to find Sinkhole Station destroyed, confirming Luke's suspicions that the station was designed to hold Abeloth. Journeying to [[Abeloth's planet]], Luke, along with Gavar, [[High Lord (Circle of Lords)|High Lord]] [[Sarasu Taalon]] and Captain [[Leeha Faal]] mindwalked in order to find Abeloth. However, she was absent from the Lake of Apparitions.<ref name="Allies" />

[[File:Abeloth_EGTW.jpg|thumb|right|200px|Skywalker fights Sith and Abeloth during the Mission to the Maw]]
Meanwhile, Vestara had purposely set Stadd loose in an attempt to find Abeloth. When the Skywalkers and Sith found him, he was able to see through Abeloth's influence after she attempted to consume his life force. Luke himself soon discovered that Abeloth had consumed his old flame Callista Ming and taken on her appearance. In the resulting battle against Abeloth, the Sith betrayed the Skywalkers and attempted to capture Abeloth. Despite fighting both Abeloth and the Sith, the Skywalkers were able to force Abeloth to retreat. Abeloth came back to Stadd's side to finish the job she started. She then projected Ming's appearance again when Luke confronted her, but the Grand Master could see through her deception. Skywalker quickly thrust his lightsaber down into what appeared to be Stadd's body. The projection of Callista recoiled, and what appeared to be Stadd's body writhed, its voice crying out as Ben and the Sith arrived on the scene. Luke ignored Ben's protest and the Sith's shouts, watching what had appeared to be Stadd's body as it morphed into that of Abeloth's true form. Abeloth seemingly died and the Jedi affected by the psychosis were freed.<ref name="Allies" />

Despite the fact that the danger was over, Luke kept Vestara on the ''Shadow'' to keep the Sith in line. Only he, Ben, Gavar, Vestara and Taalon remained on Abeloth's planet to discover more about her.<ref name="Allies" /> On the ''Shadow'', Vestara and Ben sense that [[Ship (Sith Meditation Sphere)|Ship]] was returning to the planet. Ben was able to tell his father of Ship's return and they promptly formulated a plan to steal Abeloth's body. Under the guise of stopping Vestara from being beaten by Taalon, he distracted the Sith so Ben could rush for the body. However, Vestara revealed that the body actually belonged to [[Dyon Stadd]] and the real Abeloth had escaped.<ref name="Vortex" />

[[Ship (Sith Meditation Sphere)|Ship]] subsequently arrived and greeted the group. It lied to them about not being under Abeloth's control and led them to the [[Pool of Knowledge]]. Upon looking in the pool, Ben saw an image of Abeloth running toward the allies' vessels, and he realized that she had used Ship to distract them so that she could escape. Ben insisted that they leave quickly, but Gavar wanted to wait until they were certain. The [[Throne of Balance]] appeared in the Pool with a [[Color/Legends|red]]-haired Jedi female sitting on it. Luke and Ben knew that it was Allana and when the Sith demanded to know who she was, the Skywalkers attacked the Sith. During the [[Duel at the Pool of Knowledge|duel]] Luke managed to cut off Gavar Khai's fighting arm while [[Sarasu Taalon|Taalon]] was knocked into the Pool. Luke was then struck with Force lightning, but Ben managed to intercept it with his lightsaber. The Skywalkers went to the exit and Luke used his lightsaber to cut down one of the outer columns, which resulted in the entire collapse of the entryway, temporarily trapping the Sith.<ref name="Vortex" />

They ran to the ships only to find that Abeloth has taken the ''Shadow''. With Vestara in tow, they stole the ''[[Emiax]]'' and followed her. Her trail led them to [[Pydyr]] which was the new home of the [[Fallanassi/Legends|Fallanassi]]. There they discovered that the people had been stricken with a deadly plague. While Ben and Vestara panicked, Luke used his knowledge of the White Current to discover that it was actually an [[Mind trick/Legends#Force illusion|illusion]]. He left the two teens in the ship while he searched for Abeloth. He encountered his former lover, [[Akanah Norand Goss Pell]] and was suspicious that she might be Abeloth. Although she answered all of his questions, his suspicion remained. He did discover that the Fallanassi are harboring Abeloth. After this, Ben and Vestara arrived, followed shortly by the [[Sith armada (Lost Tribe of the Sith)|Sith armada]]. Taalon was bent on finding Abeloth as he was now turning into a being like her. Skywalker agreed to help them, and on the way to the [[Fallanassi village]] he was able to trick some of the fleet into attacking some illusions. When they arrived at the village, everyone except Taalon, Vestara, and the Skywalkers were attacked by more illusions. They discovered that Abeloth had taken over Akanah's body.<ref name="Vortex" />

Abeloth led them to a cave, while she tempted Taalon with promises to tell him what he was becoming. Luke fought Abeloth once again, killing her with the lava from the cave. Before the end, Akanah took over for a moment to apologize to Skywalker. Exhausted, Luke found out that Abeloth had another body in the form of Callista Ming. This body captured him and Ben in a [[Force net]] and he was rendered unconscious. When he came to his senses, he saw that they are both about to be executed. However, Ben revealed to him that he has a plan in the form of Vestara. Skywalker was skeptical and was shocked to see Vestara kill Taalon, who she believed was becoming a puppet of Abeloth. Abeloth fled once more and Skywalker gave Vestara a chance to go back to the Sith. However, Vestara decided to remain with the Skywalkers, this time with their trust. However, they were captured by the newly freed Sith.<ref name="Vortex" />

After watching the [[StealthX wing|Stealth X's]] [[Battle in the Fallanassi village|decimate]] the [[Sith armada (Lost Tribe of the Sith)|Sith armada]], the Skywalkers were saved by [[Vestara Khai]] who killed their captors using the ''Jade Shadow''{{'s}} guns. Ben remarked to his shocked father that perhaps Vestara was not so bad after all. After a brief conversation with Lando Calrissian, who updated him on current events such as Kenth Hamner's [[Skirmish in the Operations Hangar|death]], Luke and Ben, now with Vestara, continued their search for Abeloth.<ref name="Vortex" />

====Pursuing Abeloth====
{{Quote|Luke&hellip; Join with me. Save me.&hellip;''"<br />"''I will. I will save you.|Ming's presence in Abeloth and Skywalker|<ref name="Conviction">''[[Fate of the Jedi: Conviction]]''</ref>}}
[[File:LukeExile-Outcast.jpg|thumb|right|250px|Skywalker with his lightsaber drawn]]
The Skywalkers and Vestara continued to pursue Abeloth and followed a Force pulse to [[Meliflar Station]] where they briefly [[Skirmish in Meliflar Station|skirmished]] with its inhabitants. There they learned that the crew had mutinied after Abeloth's visit and discovered that she had tainted the [[Hallaf|station owner's]] [[Fala (Human)|daughter]]. Luke healed her by merging Abeloth's dark side energy with his own light. They discovered that Abeloth was headed to [[Nam Chorios/Legends|Nam Chorios]]. The last planet Luke had ever seen Callista Ming before she was consumed by Abeloth. As they approached Nam Chorios, Luke told Ben and Vestara the history of Nam Chorios including the [[Death Seed]] Plague, and the [[Tsil]]s.<ref name="Conviction" />

They approached the planet under the names of Ben and Owen Lars, while Vestara pretended to be the ship captain. Luke warned them about the devastating consequences if they used the Force on the planet. Once planet side Luke sought out the [[Theran Listener]]s. The [[Oldtimer]]s directed Luke to the nearest healer, Sel, who Luke recognized from his last visit as [[Taselda]], the oldest known living Jedi. The last time Luke had seen her she had managed to survive for 400 years by eating live Drochs but that had deteriorated her mind to insanity. She had since been cured by the Theran Listners and accepted into their ranks. Luke warned Sel about Abeloth and expressed interest in learning the Listener technique [[Mnemotherapy]]. Sel informed the group that Abeloth's [[Ship (Sith Meditation Sphere)|Ship]] had been spotted near [[Bleak Point Station]]. Sel then brought the group to Listener-Master [[Taru Durn]] who taught Luke mnemotherapy. Shortly after the session, Abeloth used the Force to cause a powerful Force Storm. After helping as many of the storm's victims as they could Sel confronted Luke and gave her the key to her mnemotherapy which, if the need arose, could act as a backdoor to her mind.<ref name="Conviction" />

Taru then took the group to meet senior Listener-Master, [[Nenn]]. Luke told Nenn about Abeloth and her abilities, and offered to teach the Listener's how to close themselves off from the Force to prevent Abeloth from taking control of them. Nenn then told Luke that a Listener adept had been found dead and that doctor [[Cagaran Wei]] had disappeared after Abeloth had been spotted. Nenn told Luke to investigate [[Hweg Shul]], which is where the doctor lived. Luke, Ben, and Vestara met with [[Snaplaunce]], the Mayor of Hweg Shul. While investigating Dr. Wei's office the Skywalkers discovered some evidence that Dr. Wei may have been experimenting with Drochs. Through Dr. Wei's speeder they were able to determine that the doctor had been to a failed rock ivory processing camp in the mountains beyond Bleak Point. Snaplaunce offered to let the Skywalkers and Vestara use his personal shuttle, ''[[Vote Snaplaunce]]'', in order to reach the camp quickly.<ref name="Conviction" />

On their way, they where attacked by both Ship and Koval Station. Luke used his piloting skills to force Koval station to fire on Ship but Ship survived the attack however it, along with Abeloth, where injured from the death of a Tsil. Luke eventually eased the damaged shuttle down and made it to the camp, and there found Dr. Wei's corpse. Luke, Vestara, and Ben determined that Dr. Wei was killed to lure them into a trap. Luke used the Force to communicate with a Tsil and after conveying to it what Abeloth was the Tsil revealed that Listener-Master Nenn had also been consumed by Abeloth. They eventually got the shuttle working and made their way back to Hweg Shul, where they were confronted by Sel. Luke used Sel's mnemotherapy key to subdue her and found out the Listeners were indeed controlled by Abeloth and that she was hiding in a pumping station. While resting at Sel's home Ben showed Luke the latest HoloNews stories including the Jedi Coup against Daala, and that his sentence had been overturned. The group then went searching the pumping stations for Abeloth. While at one pumping station they were confronted by [[Tola Annax]], a Sith Saber under Gavar Khai. With Tola were 3 other Saber's who attack Luke, Ben, and Vestara. Each engaged in a one on one duel and the Skywalkers and Vestara emerged victorious causing Tola to flee. Luke was then contacted by [[Kandra Nilitz]], a journalist who come to the planet with Valin and Jysella Horn. When the group met up with Kandra they were again attacked by Sith and again they defeated them. Luke informed Kandra of the Lost Tribe of Sith and Abeloth in return for a ride to [[Crystal Valley (Nam Chorios)|Crystal Valley]], where Abeloth was.<ref name="Conviction" />

Once at the Crystal Valley pumping station Luke, Ben, and Vestara entered and found Theran Listener's writhing in agony on the floor. Valin Horn then appeared, still plagued by [[Force psychosis]], and told them that they were cut off from the true Force and that only Grand Master Callista Ming, Abeloth, could cure them. Abeloth then came and expressed a desire to have Luke join with her and Callista. Valin tried to attack Luke but Ben and Vestara held him off. When Abeloth opened herself to Luke he used the Force to rip Callista Ming from Abeloth. Callista's spirit was now free of Abeloth and finally felt the Light Side again as she faded into the Force. Abeloth, now wounded turned into Ninn, who with his last ounce of energy ignited a lightsaber into his chest killing him and freeing the Listeners and Valin of Abeloth's thrall. Abeloth began to escape but before the Skywalkers and Vestara could follow her they were again confronted by Tola Annax who now commanded two dozen Sith. The three fought and managed to hold off the Sith long enough for Vestara to kill a Tsil, whose [[Death convulsion]] paralyzed the Sith and allowed the the group to escape with the unconscious Valin Horn. Luke admonished Vestara for killing a Tsil but Vestara countered that only Luke had the strength to destroy Abeloth.<ref name="Conviction" />

The Sith flotilla that had brought Tola Annax was under attack by the Jedi StealthXs which Luke had kept waiting until the Sith arrived. Luke commandeered Jedi [[Tyria Sarkin Tainer]]'s StealthX and led a squadron of Jedi after Abeloth, who was fleeing in Ship. During the space battle Luke was shot down by NovaGun, but survived. Luke awoke in the Alliance Supply Navy supply ship [[Verity (Galactic Alliance)|''Verity'']]. Jaina told him that Abeloth had escaped but Luke knew that she was injured and took comfort in knowing that Callista was finally free.<ref name="Conviction" />

[[File:Skywalker_Apocalypse.jpg|thumb|left|230px|Skywalker near the end of his journey]]
Luke, Ben, Vestara, and Jaina went to [[Korriban/Legends|Korriban]] to find the [[Lost Tribe of Sith]]. While at the [[Valley of the Dark Lords/Legends|Valley of the Dark Lords]], they were attacked by a large pack of [[Tuk'ata/Legends|Tuk'ata]]. Vestara stopped the Tuk'ata and communicated with them through the [[Sith (language)|Sith]] and told them not to attack them. The Sith Hounds obeyed and Vestara asked if there were any other Sith on the planet. When the Tuk'ata replied with uneasiness because there were no other Lost Tribe Sith on the planet. The four left Korriban and traveled to [[Dromund Kaas/Legends|Dromund Kaas]], the ancient capital of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] following the [[Great Hyperspace War/Legends|Great Hyperspace War.]] When they arrived at the [[Dark Force Temple]] the group was attacked by 10 [[Sith Saber]]s led by Vestara's own father, [[Gavar Khai]]. The Jedi defeated three Sith each while Vestara [[Duel on Dromund Kaas|dueled]] her father. When Vestara realized that Gavar was under Abeloth's thrall, she killed him. Luke figured that because the Lost Tribe was actively hunting them, the main fleet must be elsewhere. Luke decided to return to Coruscant to recuperate. During the flight to Coruscant Ben and Vestara fell in love and Vestara expressed interest in becoming a Jedi. The Grand Master was shocked and disbelieving. However, when Vestara agreed to open up her presence in the Force and allow herself to be examined by Luke, he found that she was sincere in her change of heart and told her that he would teach her himself.<ref name="Ascension" />

Upon returning to the Jedi Temple Luke met with Master [[Saba Sebatyne]], who had been acting Grand Master following the death of Kenth Hamner. Luke found no fault in Saba for she was doing what was best for the Order and Hamner had given her no other choice. After meeting with Saba Luke summoned the rest of the High Council and proposed his idea for the Jedi to leave Coruscant for the time being, so as not to appear to be a part of the Government. Most of the Masters agreed except for Saba who told Luke that the [[Barabel/Legends|Barabel]] Jedi would not leave the Temple. Luke compromised by allowing to the Barabel's to remain and keep watch over the Temple.<ref name="Ascension" />

Luke then met up with Leia and the current members of the Triumvirate. Luke informed them that the Jedi would be withdrawing from their position of authority in the Galactic Alliance, and how the Order would be hunting down Abeloth and the Sith. He also suggested that, until a proper election could be held, that [[Wynn Dorvan]] serve as the Chief of State, to which Wynn reluctantly agreed. Later, in a public ceremony, Luke and the Jedi Order left Coruscant.<ref name="Ascension" />

While traveling to Upekzar, to find Abeloth and [[Ship (Sith Meditation Sphere)|Ship]], Ben and Vestara saw Leia being arrested at the behest of Senator Kameron Suldar, whom Vestara recognized as High Lord [[Ivaar Workan]]. To Ben and Vestara's surprise Luke was not startled and he admitted that leaving Coruscant was a plan designed by him and the Council to lure the Sith out of hiding, and that after dealing with Abeloth they would return to defeat the Sith.<ref name="Ascension" />

After Abeloth devastated Coruscant with seismic activity and also kidnapped Vestara and Ben, Luke left for the Realm Beyond Shadows to destroy Abeloth. There, he encountered Darth Krayt. He managed to see through Krayt's attempted lie about being a member of the Lost Tribe of the Sith, but worked with him anyhow in order to stop Abeloth by destroying all of her avatar bodies, eventually destroying her from within the realm. Afterwards, both left, severely wounded but alive. Luke from this encounter also became privy to [[One Sith|another faction of the Sith]], the one to which Darth Krayt belonged. Afterwards, remembering the story Yoda told him about Anakin Skywalker and Obi-Wan's encounter with the Ones on Mortis during the Clone Wars, Luke studied up on the records of this in the aftermath of Abeloth's defeat. After learning the full history from the documents that confirmed Yoda's story, Luke later sent a [[Quest Knights|Jedi Task force]] to locate the Mortis Monolith to retrieve the [[Dagger of Mortis/Legends|Dagger of Mortis]] as a means of destroying Abeloth for good as insurance in case Abeloth returned from the dead.<ref name="Apocalypse">''[[Fate of the Jedi: Apocalypse]]''</ref>

====Investigating the Chiloon Rift====
Responding to a transmission from Han Solo regarding the questionable activities of the [[Galactic Exploitation Technologies]] company, Luke initiated an incognito rendezvous with [[Sullustan]] Senator [[Luewet Wuul]] on Coruscant, where he was enlightened to the criminal activities of [[Marvid Qreph|Marvid]] and [[Craitheus Qreph]] in the Chiloon Rift. This was part of an ambitious hostile takeover of practically every major industry in the galaxy.<ref name="Crucible" />

After Luke departed to the Chiloon Rift to meet up with Han and Leia, Han was captured by Mirta Gev and Savara, who were working for the Qrephs. After saving Han from their frigate, the ''[[Ormni]]'', Luke, Han, and Leia travel to the Qreph's [[Base Prime]], located atop a mysterious monolith in space. In the ensuing battle, which led to a mysterious world where the Qreph brothers gained extraordinary Force powers, Luke killed [[Savara Two]], an insane clone of Vestara Khai. After the defeat of the Qrephs, Luke and Leia mysteriously vanished -- leaving Han alone. Han coaxed Leia back into existence by uttering her name, while Luke was brought back by Leia uttering his name. Now enlightened by this mysterious monolith in the balancing nature of the Force -- both the light side and the dark requiring each other, Luke made the proper precautions to ensure that the monolith never again fell into misuse. A tired, elderly Luke, wisened but hardened by decades of conflict against the forces of the dark side, relaxed at a cantina surrounded by friends and family: Leia, Han, Lando, Ben, Vestara, Tahiri, [[Omad Kaeg]], [[Ohali Soroc]], and Jaina and Jagged Fel.<ref name="Crucible" />

===Death and legacy===
{{Quote|Every generation has its challenges to face, its own battles to win. Why should yours be any different? Running away from your responsibilities won't solve anything!|Luke Skywalker's Force ghost to Cade Skywalker|<ref name="Legacy 3" />}}
[[File:Luke_Force_Ghost_Leg0.png|thumb|150px|Luke Skywalker, having become one with the Force, would converse with his descendant, Cade Skywalker, on multiple occasions.]]
At some point prior to the year [[137 ABY]], Luke passed away. When he died, he united his spirit with the Force like his father and his mentors. A century after the Yuuzhan Vong War, Luke Skywalker's Jedi fell to the One Sith, the secret faction led by Darth Krayt. Following the fall of the Jedi and Krayt's take over of the reborn [[Darth Krayt's Galactic Empire|Galactic Empire]], Luke's descendant [[Cade Skywalker]] became a [[Pirate/Legends|pirate]] and a [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]], which lead to Luke pleading with him&mdash;repeatedly, and over the course of many meetings&mdash;to turn back to the Force and the Jedi way.<ref name="Legacy 3" /> 

Later, Luke would again appear before Cade in a Force vision, urging him to right his wrongs and free the Jedi [[Hosk Trey'lis]], who Cade had previously given to the Sith.<ref name="Legacy 12">[[Legacy (2006) 12|''Legacy'' (2006) 12]]</ref> Luke would later appear with his descendant and Cade's father, [[Kol Skywalker]], in an attempt to persuade Cade to stop using [[Death stick/Legends|death sticks]] and to warn Cade that there would be upcoming events that would envelop him and those he cared about, and that he had to be ready.<ref name="Legacy 24">[[Legacy (2006) 24|''Legacy'' (2006) 24]]</ref>

[[File:SWLegacy39.jpg|thumb|left|150px|Luke Skywalker dueled his descendant on Tatooine in a force vision.]]
Nonetheless, Cade tried running again after paying the consequences from his assassination of Krayt. On Tatooine, he was caught by a sandstorm with his unknown half-sister [[Gunn Yage]], though Luke appeared once again as a Force ghost, guiding him to his childhood home: the [[Lars homestead/Legends|Lars homestead]]. Afterward, Luke appeared before Cade in a vision, reflecting that he too lost family to the Sith and the Empire, before warning him that he was skirting closer to the dark side than he thought. Luke also reminded his wayward descendant that even if he tried running from his destiny, the galaxy would never leave him alone.<ref name="Legacy 39">[[Legacy (2006) 39|''Legacy'' (2006) 39]]</ref> 

When Cade was searching for [[Vul Isen]], he became frustrated that he could not find him. Luke appeared to Cade again and told him that he could not find Isen because he had no plan. He suggested that Cade should finish his Jedi training so that he could anticipate Isen's movements. He then told Cade that he had a great trial coming and that he needed to be ready. When Cade realized his friend [[Jariah Syn]] was watching him interact with Luke, he asked Syn if he could see Luke, and both Jariah and Luke responded with no.<ref name="Legacy 48">[[Legacy (2006) 48|''Legacy'' (2006) 48]]</ref>

====Final encounter with Cade Skywalker====
{{Quote|You are a ''Jedi''. Time to choose your ''own'' path.|Luke Skywalker, to Cade Skywalker|<ref name="War 6">[[Legacy — War 6|''Legacy — War'' 6]]</ref>}}
During the [[Battle of Coruscant (Second Imperial Civil War)|Battle of Coruscant]], Cade finally embraced his Jedi heritage and killed Darth Krayt. He then took his mother's ship to [[Coruscant Prime/Legends|Coruscant Prime]], intending to burn Krayt's body to ensure that he would not return again. Cade also resolved to die as Krayt had infected his mind, intending to take over Cade's body. Luke appeared to Cade and told him that as a Jedi, he could either give into fear and die with Krayt or choose hope and live. Cade listened to his ancestor and ejected as Krayt's body was incinerated by the sun.<ref name="War 6" />

==Personality and traits==
{{Quote|This one, a long time have I watched. All his life has he looked away. To the future. To the horizon. Never his mind on where he was&hellip; what he was doing! Adventure, heh! Excitement, heh!&hellip; A Jedi craves not these things. You are reckless!|Yoda|<ref name="Episode V" />}}
[[File:LukeSkywalker-SQ.jpg|thumb|left|190px|Skywalker as a Jedi Master]]
In his youth, Luke was often impatient, looking ahead to the future with little regard for his present surroundings. Like his father, he was impulsive, reckless, and often had little regard for his own personal safety.<ref name="Episode IV" /> According to Han Solo, his first impression of Skywalker was a naïve kid who needed to be taught a thing or two.<ref name="Hero for Hire">''[[Star Wars Journal: Hero for Hire]]''</ref>  Once he became a Jedi Master, bringing back the Jedi Order was his highest goal.<ref name=":3">[[Dark Empire II 3|''Dark Empire II'' 3]]</ref>

However, as his skills in the Force progressed and after losing a hand to Darth Vader, Luke became more patient and seasoned, and was often seen as having wisdom beyond his years. However, he still retained his idealistic worldview of his youth, believing that Vader was redeemable.<ref name="Episode VI" /> Likewise, he was compassionate to Mara Jade when he met her and polite to Karrde and offered to deal fairly with his captor.<ref name="Heir to the Empire" /> This belief would stay with him for his entire life, as he would go so far as to spare the Sith Lumiya because he believed she could be redeemed, despite the fact there was much evidence to the contrary and a pressing need to have her eliminated.<ref name="Tempest" /> Some called Skywalker naïve for this, although it was actually his kindness and ability to see the good in others that forced him to view others this way.<ref name="Exile" /><ref name="Sacrifice" /> This somewhat soft stance on discipline and errant behavior at the Jedi Praxeum indirectly led to the attacks by the spirit of Exar Kun on his students.<ref name="Jedi Search" /><ref name="Champions of the Force" /><ref name="Dark Apprentice" /> By the time of Abeloth's rampage, he had become a bit colder, especially disliking Sith.<ref name="Apocalypse" />

Luke struggled with the temptation of the dark side of the Force several times through his life, sometimes doubting both his actions (like wondering if curiosity was a danger and being unsure if lying was appropriate for a Jedi) and the way he used his powers,<ref name="Heir to the Empire" /> even during his service as a Jedi Master. Hoping he can destroy his tyranny from the inside, he pledged his loyalty to the reborn Palpatine as the Sith Lord's apprentice and allowed the dark side to gain control over him. After this he was often conflicted about his role in the Force and had his judgment clouded, until Mara Jade and Corran Horn helped free him of the dark side's influence.<ref name="Vision of the Future" /> This type of inner conflict would reemerge in the Yuuzhan Vong War, where Luke struggled with how the Jedi should approach the war<ref name="Destiny's Way" /> and when he tried to fight with the power of dark side against the Vong virus threatening the life of Jade and his yet unborn son.

He hungered for knowledge, first of his family,<ref name="Episode IV" /> then progressing to wanting to know about Obi-Wan, Vader, and the rise of the Empire;<ref name="Episode VI" /> and on to general Jedi history. For example, during the first battle he fought while feeling like a full Jedi Knight, he wondered if the Jedi of the old Republic had used mental powers to confuse enemy pilots.<ref name="Heir to the Empire" /> He also sought to learn of the Force, both to learn new powers<ref name=":5" /> and the wider lore of other users and what his place was.<ref name="The Jedi Path: A Manual for Students of the Force (real-life book)" />

Luke was an observent man, noticing that Karrde's pet Vornskrs had been de-tailed and that Mara Jade had some lightsaber training from how she used his stolen blade.<ref name="Heir to the Empire" />

After the death of his wife Mara Jade Skywalker, Luke felt that his world had ended.<ref name="Sacrifice" /> Abandoning the way of the Jedi, he pursued the alleged murderer of Jade and killed her in cold blood. The weight of his grief would burden him even as the Jedi Order looked to him for leadership and his son Ben fell perilously close to the dark side of the Force.<ref name="Inferno" /> However, Luke would eventually accept that his duty was to lead the Jedi and he returned to the forefront of the order, leading a series of missions against the Sith Lord Darth Caedus.<ref name="Fury" />

[[File:LukeSkywalkersign.png|thumb|200px|Skywalker's signature]]
Luke was known for being empathetic to his friends and would go to great lengths to help them, whenever he could. At some times, he could be almost passive, serene&mdash;a result of his mastery of the Force that allowed him to remain calm and in control even in the heat of battle. His loyalty and devotion to his comrades was virtually unshakable.<ref name="Episode VI" />

Some Yuuzhan Vong came to view him as the avatar of their god of war, Yun-Yammka.<ref name="The Unifying Force" />

==Powers and abilities==
===Lightsaber abilities===
{{Quote|I am always prepared to fight when I must, and who I must.|Luke Skywalker, to [[High Lord (Circle of Lords)|High Lord]] [[Sarasu Taalon]] |<ref name="Allies" />}}
[[File:Conflict_and_Combat_FDCR.png|thumb|right|260px|Skywalker duels his father.]]
Though Luke received little training and was mostly self-taught, he became an exceptionally skilled Jedi in combat, making him one of the most skilled Jedi to ever live. Without a master, it was his natural and unparalleled aptitude that contributed in the impossible advancement of his skills. On Bespin, Luke revealed that he was an extraordinarily gifted duelist after only one brief session with Obi-Wan Kenobi, and later, Yoda, able to pose a challenge to his much more experienced father, visibly impressing Vader. By the time he boarded the second Death Star, Luke had improved his abilities to stand on equal footing with Vader despite not fighting to kill. Upon being angered by Vader's threat of corrupting Leia, Luke mirrored Darth Vader's own Form V technique and responded with his own furious demonstration of Form V's raw power. Luke Skywalker's use of [[Form V/Legends|Form V]] is probably as much instinctive as trained, leaving observing swordsmen, such as Palpatine, astonished at such instantaneous learning in a lightsaber duel. This ferocious display of blade work allowed Luke to quickly drive back and defeat Vader fairly quickly. However, Luke's particular form of lightsaber combat may in the end be something entirely new, with traces of [[Form III/Legends|Form III]], [[Form IV/Legends|Form IV]] and Form V mixed together with his own techniques. After the fateful duel, however, Luke also studied some lightsaber techniques from Kenobi's journal and greatly advanced his abilities.

Luke applied the very opposite of [[Dun Möch/Legends|Dun Möch]] on board the second Death Star by infusing love into Darth Vader's heart through spoken words. The young Jedi was successful&mdash;Anakin Skywalker ultimately redeemed himself and [[Chosen One/Legends|brought balance to the Force]].<ref name="Episode VI" />

As a Jedi Master, Luke particularly took the time to write in the margins noting how compassion was a key element to mastering Form V, indicating he had some degree of knowledge of the finer points in the Form as of at least that point.<ref name="The Jedi Path: A Manual for Students of the Force (real-life book)">[[The Jedi Path: A Manual for Students of the Force (real-life book)|''The Jedi Path: A Manual for Students of the Force'']]</ref> He also mastered the [[strong style]], a form of lightsaber combat that resembles Djem So that is used in the New Jedi Order.<ref name="Jedi Knight: Jedi Academy" /> Luke also revealed having knowledge and skill in the use of Ataru. Skywalker learned the form from Yoda and passed it on to his students, teaching them to embrace it not as a weapon of first use, but to use both their weapon and their body in practicing Ataru. Luke Skywalker was known to possess some skill in Soresu, using it to deflect blaster bolts.

On Myrkr, after screaming like a Krayt Dragon, he cut a Vornskr in half after snatching his saber from Mara Jade's belt, though he surrendered his weapon when she pointed a gun a him, knowing he could not protect himself from her shots without the Force to guide his defence. During his escape from Myrkr, with Ysalamri all around the world, he was forced to use cover and avoid blasterfire, unlike how if he could touch the Force, he could indefinitely deflect blaster bolts. He also took out a group of Stormtroopers and brought down an arch by hurling his lightsaber at it.<ref name="Heir to the Empire" />

In the fight against Palpatine, during [[Operation Shadow Hand]], he rebelled against the reborn Emperor. Luke fought Palpatine two times; the first duel (just after the Emperor abandoned his dying body in an Essence Transfer explosion and Luke slashed up all but two of the blank clone bodies) ended with Luke being quickly defeated, although it must be noted he could still battle against Palpatine despite the latter's overwhelming ferocity and versatility as well as immense dueling prowess and far greater experience for a fair share of time,<ref name="Dark Empire 5" /> but in their final duel, despite being stunned by lightning before the fight, boosted by Leia's Force Harmony, Luke stalemated and eventually triumphed over Palpatine in a duel so intense that Leia could hardly see the movements of Luke as he engaged the Emperor, but she sensed titanic waves of power generating from them&mdash;dark from the Emperor, and light from Luke, slicing off the Emperor's hand with ''[[Cho mai/Legends|cho mai]]'', defeating Palpatine,<ref name="Star Wars: Dark Empire (audio)">[[Dark Empire (audio drama)|''Dark Empire'' audio drama]]</ref><ref name="Dark Empire 6" /> whose skills in lightsaber combat and ferocity previously made only Windu ever defeat him in fair combat.<ref name="Episode III" /> When the Ysanna riders shot a barrage of gunbow arrows at Luke and Kam, the Jedi slashed the Force-aimed bolts apart without any trouble. They then worked with the natives to fight darktroopers for tweenty minutes.<ref name=":3" /> The Jedi Master went on to train two of the Ysanna in Jedi saber combat.<ref name=":4">[[Dark Empire II 5|''Dark Empire II'' 5]]</ref> During a [[Mission to Vjun (Operation Shadow Hand)|mission to rescue some shamans]], Luke and three other Jedi fought through a mass of the Dark Side Elite, with Skywalker himself disarming and capturing their leader, Xecr Nist while using lightning to indirectly kill most of the rest.<ref name=":6" />

[[File:Soresu.jpg|thumb|left|230px|Skywalker using Soresu]]
Luke also had developed amazing dueling skills with dual blades. During the Yuuzhan Vong War, when his nephew, Jacen Solo, was captured by the Yuuzhan Vong, Luke wielded his own blade, as well as Jacen's, and easily defeated three Yuuzhan Vong Warriors, before freeing Jacen.<ref name="Dark Tide I" /> He also applied dual-blade combat to great effect when against Lumiya, who wielded a Lightwhip. In their rematch, Skywalker used his newly fabricated shoto to back up his full-length lightsaber, entangling the energy beams of her whip with one blade while cutting apart the physical strands. Skywalker managed to disarm Lumiya by shorting out the energy beam of her whip with a power attack, though he lost his lightsaber in the process, before he attacked her with the shoto.

Later in the Yuuzhan Vong War, Luke participated in the Battle of Artorias and defeated over a dozen Yuuzhan Vong Warriors.<ref name="Invasion1" /> Luke's abilities with a lightsaber allowed him to fight his way through countless Yuuzhan Vong warriors in the Sacred Precinct. After defeating numerous Yuuzhan Vong warriors in Shimrra's Citadel, Luke defeated more than five Slayers; while Kyp Durron, one of the most powerful Jedi of his time, could not best the Slayers who were exposed to Alpha Red. Afterward, Luke slew Supreme Overlord Shimrra Jamaane, who was stated to be the best warrior of the Yuuzhan Vong, despite being injured by the poison of the Scepter of Power.<ref name="The Unifying Force" />

Later into the war, Luke led the Jedi against Jacen and faked his death to infiltrate the ''Anakin Solo''. Luke saw Jacen, who was unknown to Luke at this point the Sith Lord Darth Caedus, torturing his son Ben. Luke leaped and began a prolonged duel with Jacen, at which although he too sustained severe injuries, he inflicted more on his nephew and slowly gained the upper hand before ultimately besting him with aid from his son,<ref name="Inferno" /> after which Caedus acknowledged Luke was the superior duelist.

During the Battle of Tenupe, Luke dueled Raynar Thul, who at the time could draw on the Force energy of every single nest member and Joiner, and was able to defeat him by cutting off his dominant hand. Before he could get Raynar to surrender he was attacked by the Queen of the Dark Nest, Lomi Plo. Although Lomi Plo wielded two lightsabers, Luke was still able to block her attacks and kill her by slicing her into four pieces, thus destroying the Dark Nest and ending the Swarm War.<ref name="Dark Nest III: The Swarm War" />

[[File:Luke_Skywalker_SWGTCG.jpg|thumb|right|230px|Skywalker with his custom-built lightsaber]]
During Luke's exile, the Lost Tribe of Sith sent out a strike team to kill the Jedi Grand Master. Despite being outnumbered, Luke along side Ben, fought his way through approximately fifteen Sith until only the Sith Lady, Olaris Rhea, and her apprentice, Vestara Khai, remained. Luke dueled the both of them and killed Olaris, only allowing Vestara to escape so he could track her with a [[Blood trail|Blood Trail]].<ref name="Abyss" />

While looking for the Sith on Dromund Kaas, Luke, Ben, Vestara and Jaina Solo were attacked by ten Sith sabers led by Gavar Khai. Despite being outnumbered and the Sith powered by Dromund Kaas' dark side nexus, the Jedi and Vestara fought them. Luke and Jaina fought back to back, bonded by the Force, in perfect harmony and defeated six attacking Sith.<ref name="Ascension" /> This fight, among other things, displayed that Luke had great skill in working in unison with other combatants.

Luke practiced and specialized in Form V, his father's [[Lightsaber combat/Legends|lightsaber combat]] style even though he was known to use an Form IV opening stance. He was also known to utilize two lightsabers in the [[Jar'Kai/Legends|Jar'Kai]] style.<ref name="FJLC">{{InsiderCite|62|Fightsaber: Jedi Lightsaber Combat}}</ref>

===Force powers===
{{Quote|Yeah, well, if he's such a great Jedi, how come I have to keep rescuing him?|Han Solo, to Mon Mothma|<ref name="Dark Empire 3">[[Dark Empire 3|''Dark Empire'' 3]]</ref>}}
Luke Skywalker inherited immense levels of strength in the Force from his father, enough so as to actually exceed Anakin, giving him the Force potential to become what his father was supposed to become&mdash;the Force potential of the Chosen One.<ref name="ESBDC">{{Film|V}} Director's Commentary</ref>
Ever since then, Luke greatly advanced his skills and powers in the Force, becoming incredibly skilled in a great number of [[Force power/Legends|Force powers]] and was considered to be the most powerful Force Sensitive in history by some.

====Jedi Knight====
During the Battle of Yavin, Luke managed to destroy the first Death Star by letting the Force tell him when to fire his proton torpedoes, while traveling at very high speeds, not knowing the distance to the port, and having no previous knowledge of proton torpedoes and their capabilities. Astonishingly, Luke only had little training with the Force at the time.<ref name="Episode IV" /> Luke's first conscious use of the Force was to locate a lost [[Screwdriver/Legends|screwdriver]] under a couch, when he was only 6 years old.

Five years after his due with Vader, he admitted to himself that neither he nor his father had unleashed their full Force powers in that conflict and stated that Yoda was more powerful than either of them.<ref name="Heir to the Empire" />

[[File:LukeSkywalker-NEGTC.png|thumb|left|190px|Luke Skywalker was one of the most powerful Force users in history of the galaxy.]]
Only a short time after being given a lightsaber by Obi-Wan, Luke was able to instinctively block several blaster bolts fired in rapid succession by a remote, despite his lack of prolonged formal training. Without any guidance except a handbook left by Obi-Wan Kenobi, Luke Skywalker successfully built his first lightsaber, merely three years after he was first introduced to the Force, and undergoing formal training for less than a year. Further testament to this was shown when Luke was able to successfully [[Mind trick/Legends|Mind trick]] a stormtrooper into disregarding his concealed lightsaber, roughly two months after he had first seen Ben Kenobi perform it.<ref name="Star Wars #8">[[Star Wars (2013) 8|''Star Wars'' (2013) 8]]</ref> Much as he had used the Force to befuddle Jabba's guards, Luke used the Force to [[Dim Other's Senses|dim the senses]] of a group of TIE pilots during the battle over Nomad City. He ended up mind-tricking them into fleeing over the course of a thirty minute event, though his attention was hijacked by a telepathic communication by C'Baoth and he did his flying and tricking unconsciously, on reflex as guided by the Force.<ref name="Heir to the Empire" /> 

He sometimes [[Telepathy/Legends|sent his thoughts]] to his sister, such as mentally telling her her name to prove he was not a spy crewing an X-wing. He could not, however lock onto C'baoth's mind when the Jedi clone contracted him during the Empire's raid to steal Mole Minners. After that, Luke mused that communication with the Force felt different from trying to affect others' minds. When his ship was damaged by Thrawn's, he went all out trying to hurl his thoughts to Leia, but as she was Kashyyyk in a different star system, Luke could not send much more than a vague sense of ill tidings to her.<ref name="Heir to the Empire" /> He [[Force empathy/Legends|emphatically]] felt the Emperor’s anger and helplessness when he was thrown down a Death Star shaft.<ref name="The Last Command" /> Then, when he was picked up the Kardde's people, he felt Mara Jade's hate for him, a hate he thought was even more than what Palpatine felt for him over Endor. After he got free of Myrkr, he also at one point picked up a feeling strange that Han Solo had.<ref name="Heir to the Empire" />

By the time of going to save Han Solo from Jabba, Luke had learned how to [[Alter Environment|control the environment]] to defend himself and others.<ref name="Star Wars Miniatures">[[Champions of the Force (Star Wars Miniatures)|''Champions of the Force'' {{C|Star Wars Miniatures}}]]</ref>

The Skywalker was also frighteningly proficient in the more personal applications of the Force and had a range of healing skills. After being seemingly fatally wounded in the battle between the Singing Mountain Clan and the Nightsisters, Luke was able to instinctively [[Force healing/Legends|heal himself]] in the span of mere hours.<ref name="The Courtship of Princess Leia" /> Twice, after being left in his damaged X-Wing after having fled from Thrawn, Luke had to go into [[Hibernation trance/Legends|hibernation trances]]. If he had a moment, he could [[Resist Stun|resist being stunned]] with at least two techniques. He also could slow down his heart. On Mykr, he attempted to detoxify his body but could not use it without the Force. He did, however, use the non-Force aspects of his healing training to resist an itch.<ref name="Heir to the Empire" />

With guidance from the voice of Ben Kenobi, Luke gave in to the Force and found that time seemed to slow down considerably, allowing him fight with dramatically enhanced reflexes. Luke describes the feeling as if he didn't feel in control of the power and instead felt that it was the Force guiding his actions. Luke was also skilled in the use of [[Force jump/Legends|Force Jump]], using it to avoid being frozen in carbonite during his duel with Darth Vader. 

Luke could also augment his piloting skills with the Force, using this talent to fly on reflex for a half-hour without even meaning to when C'Baoth called to him during the battle of Nomad City, when he was almost captured by Thrawn.<ref name="Heir to the Empire" /> 

Before meeting Yoda, he was able to rearm himself by pulling his blade out of snow.<ref name=":0">{{Film|V}}</ref> Likewise, Luke safely landed himself and Isolder from a free fall drop from orbit with the Force. Luke also could strangle his enemies, such as to try to subdue them into not fighting him, when he closed off a woman's throat in an effort to make the dark witch surrender.<ref name="The Courtship of Princess Leia" /> When jumped by the Nogri, he used the Force to make one of their Stokhli spray stick's triggers go off, ripped a large tapestry from a wall (thought he could not do the same for the webbed ones in the heat of battle), and when forced to kill, locked onto seven of the kidnappers in his mind and slew them with a saber throw. He turned off a training remote, telekinetically reaimed a torpedo so that it would blow up a freighter the Empire was using, and pulled R2 towards himself so the droid would be sucked up with him onto Kardde's ship.<ref name="Heir to the Empire" />

In 9 ABY, while staying on Coruscant, Luke again showed his skills of sensing just after he communed with Obi-Wan's ghost for the second to last time. He felt someone coming up behind him but not that it was a droid who was coming near and also could feel the close by persons of his sister and her two unborn children. Then at Bimmisaari, he tried to [[Truth-sense|use his powers to feel if the Bimms were liars. Regarding his power to feel lies]], he also thought he could sense a lie told to him over ship-to-ship coms. He assumed that he could feel droids and people alike in another ship, though of course he could do nothing to use the Force to feel in the voids of the Ysalamiri, his powers unable to feel those in a close ship or in the room he was in and the forest close at hand.<ref name="Heir to the Empire" />

====Jedi Master====
{{Quote|Leia... Help me... I have gone too far into the Dark Side... I found knowledge there... All the dark things father knew so well... The ability to control others... To destroy others if I so choose [...] But I had to do it Leia. I had to know my father... And why he chose the Dark Side.|Luke Skywalker, breaking free from the Emperor's influence and renouncing the Dark Side|<ref name="Dark Empire 6" />}}
By the time he was ready to take on the mantle of being a Jedi Master, Luke Skywalker was a very powerful and wise Jedi.<ref name="Dark Empire" /> He viewed learning as many Force powers as possible to be the duty of a Jedi and would go on to do just that.<ref name=":5">[[Dark Empire II 6|''Dark Empire II'' 6]]</ref> When he got ahold of them via the ''Book of Sith'', he studied the Sith teachings of Jen'Jidai, Darths Bane and Sidious, elements of Darth Plagueis's notes of how to create and alter life, and Nightsister works, though for the most part he felt these dark ideas and powers had little place for him, at least as used by the servants of darkness.<ref name=":7">''[[Book of Sith: Secrets from the Dark Side]]''</ref>

Skywalker's skill with telekinesis was as remarkable as it was overwhelming. During the Imperial civil war battle on the capital word, he flung a pack of Neks around with the Force, then after focusing hard he was able to knock down an AT-AT by pressing against the already-crippled walker with the Force.<ref name="Dark Empire">[[Dark Empire 1|''Dark Empire'' 1]]</ref><ref name="Star Wars: Dark Empire (audio)" /> Shortly thereafter, he casually flicked some men when the held him at gunpoint on Byss,<ref name=":2">[[Dark Empire 2|''Dark Empire'' 2]]</ref> and disarmed Han Solo with a wave of his cyborg stump.<ref name="Dark Empire 4" /> When Palpatine reincarnated in a clone body right before him, Skywalker subjected the Sith Lord to a Force strike, sending the Emperor slamming against a wall.<ref name="Dark Empire 5" /> On Ossus in 10 ABY, Skywalker and Kam used the Force [[Force barrier/Legends|to hedge out incoming physical attacks]], and when Sedriss tried to telekinetically break Kam's neck, Skywalker used a technique he learned from the Jedi Holocron to block the attack and save his student, then Force slammed the dark Jedi to his knees.<ref name=":3" /> When Odd Bnar sacrificed himself, Skywalker used another Force wall to keep the [[beam of light]] from killing any Jedi as the ancient master took out Sedriss.<ref>[[Dark Empire II (audio drama)|''Dark Empire II'' {{C|audio}}]]</ref> In the middle of a massive midday meal food fight at the Jedi Praxeum's mess hall, Skywalker instantly [[Force Stasis/Legends|froze]] every morsel, drop and item, solid and liquid in midair as if trapped in time, only falling after he had consciously released everything within the room.<ref name="Young Jedi Knights: Heirs of the Force" /> Similarly, during the Black Fleet Crisis, he used the Force to rebuild Darth Vader's old fortress on Coruscant.<ref name="Before the Storm" /> He would later use the Force to crush the rebuilt fortress to rubble, shattering the building piece by piece and throwing the remains into the oceans of Coruscant.<ref name="Tyrant's Test" />

Among other Force powers Luke had under his disposal, he was particularly skilled in mental powers. During the ''Eye of Palpatine'' incident, he subconsciously used his Force powers to overcome a particularly vicious form of brainwashing, able to easily siphon all the information he was seeking.<ref name="Children of the Jedi" /> While searching for the kidnapped Solo children, he used the Force to create an [[Mind trick/Legends#Force illusion|illusion]] over his face in order to disguise his identity.<ref name="The Crystal Star" /> After the Black Fleet Crisis, with new found knowledge from the White Current, Luke removed the [[Teljkon Vagabond]] from view using the Force.<ref name="Tyrant's Test" /> During the [[Death Seed]] Plague, he used the Force to mentally communicate with the sentient crystals [[Tsil]]s; despite the fact that the more dissimilar the type of mind, the more difficult it is to communicate with via the Force.<ref name="Planet of Twilight" /> Skywalker also had some skill in using the beast trick Force skill, having taught it to his sibling.<ref name="Dark Empire" /> He noted that one possible application of telepathy was to calm down someone in distress.<ref name=":7" />

The Jedi Master had a very powerful and wide-ranging [[Force sense/Legends|Force sense]]. He sensed when the reborn Palpatine sent was about to send a Force storm to collect him. Luke also could sometimes sense Jedi at a distance, sometimes their degree of power, if they were on the dark side, and when robots were about to attack him.<ref name="Dark Empire" /> The Jedi also picked up on Palpatine's sheer power and darkness when on Byss, plus the Sith's intrusion on his mind, though he kept him out.<ref name=":2" /> When Palpatine [[Enhance Force Sensitivity|invested his dark Jedi with new Force connection]], Luke felt the ripples in the Force and knew the Emperor yet lived again.<ref name="Dark Empire II 4">[[Dark Empire II 4|''Dark Empire II'' 4]]</ref> When Leia joined him on Byss, he was able to expel dark side clouding his mind.<ref name="Dark Empire 5" /> The Jedi Master was able to [[Sense Force|perceive that other Force-users]] were on Ossus, the Ysanna,<ref name=":3" /> though he missed movements of the Force sheathed dark Jedi who raided [[New Alderaan/Legends|New Alderaan]], which he regretted as a lazy error on his part.<ref name=":5" /> During the [[Disciples of Ragnos crisis]], he sensed that a missing [[Rosh Penin]] was still alive.<ref name="Jedi Knight: Jedi Academy" /> 

Luke also could sometimes [[Farsight/Legends|clairvoyantly see things across the galaxy]].<ref name="Dark Empire" /> While a prisoner on an [[Lictor-class dungeon ship|Imperial dungeon ship]] after being picked up by a Force storm, Luke was able to [[Force sight|use the Force to see through]] the Beskar walls and ascertain what sort of ship he was on.<ref name=":2" /> The Jedi Master sometimes had Force visions, such as when he saw a possible future where Jaina, Jacen, and Anakin Solo all stood together as champions of a revived Jedi Order in a peaceful galaxy.<ref name=":5" /> He could follow the chains of might-be to try to deduce the most likely events of the futures he divined.<ref name="Dark Empire" /> An example of a vision he had is when he had a bad dream, warning him that danger was coming just before he got married.<ref name="Union 2">[[Union 2|''Union'' 2]]</ref>

By 10 ABY, his powers of Force healing had developed some more, such that he could improve his own healing and give up his own health to aid others. Luke could also [[Crucitorn (technique)|endure pain]] and [[Force Sustenance|resist hunger and thirst with the Force]].<ref name="Dark Empire" /> When [[Battle of New Alderaan (Operation Shadow Hand)|poisoned during a kidnapping attempt]] by [[Scarab Mark VI assassin droid|Scarab droids]], though, Luke needed Da-Boda to heal him.<ref name=":5" />

[[File:Luke_Skywalker-HBDE.jpg|thumb|left|100px|Luke Skywalker had a wide range of powers from the light and dark sides of the Force.]]Befitting his title as Jedi Master, Luke also mastered a plethora of rare and difficult Force powers. In 10 ABY, Luke was able to destroy a group of hot-wired battle droids just by waving his hand, subtly [[Ionize|displacing their master servos]] and causing the self-destruction of the group of droids. Luke also could [[Sound mimicry|cause scary sounds]] with his light side powers, like Obi-Wan once did.<ref name="Dark Empire" /><ref name="Star Wars: Dark Empire (audio)" /> Ionize was first manifested by Jedi Master [[Arca Jeth]] during the [[Great Droid Revolution]]. Even then, with proper instruction, it was a difficult power to master. However, this power apparently came naturally to Luke. When fighting on Coruscant after it fell to the Empire, he also [[Tutaminis|absorbed]] the initial cannon blasts from the AT-AT, before deflecting the rest with his lightsaber.<ref name="Dark Empire" /><ref name="Star Wars: Dark Empire (audio)" /> More Tutaminis was shown by Luke, who blocked lightning from the Ysaana tribe.<ref name=":3" /> While he was re-creating the Jedi Order and was searching for potential candidates, he walked on lava while still throbbing with the Force after defeating a [[Fireworm/Legends|Fireworm]] living in the lava just moments before. Luke's performance impressed Gantoris so much that he decided to become Luke's apprentice.<ref name="Jedi Search" /> Luke also had some skill in [[Force suppression|dispelling Force powers]] like Sith Magic, ending [[Qâzoi Kyantuska|Palpatine's spell]] that had kept Kam Solusar enslaved to the dark side after defeating the then-dark Jedi and offering him freedom.<ref name="Star Wars: Dark Empire (audio)" /> To protect his students on Yavin 4, Luke [[Aura of uneasiness|imbued the grounds with the Force, so to keep away]] the local  Piranha beetles.<ref>[[The Essential Guide to Alien Species (real-world book)|''The Essential Guide to Alien Species'' <small>(real-world book)</small>]]</ref>
He formed a [[Force-bond/Legends|Force bond]] with Jem Ysanna when she was crouched over top him and they looked into each other's eyes. This bond allowed them to overcome their lack of understanding each other's languages.<ref name=":3" /> This bond let them passively get to know facts about each other as they loved each other.<ref name=":4" /> After this bond formed, he found he [[Comprehend Speech|could understand the tribe's words]].<ref name=":3" /> During the [[Third Battle of Yavin|Battle of the Jedi Praxeum]] Luke used the Force to [[Battle meditation/Legends|bolster]] his students engaged in battle.<ref name="Jedi Under Siege" /> During the Kueller crisis, Luke prepared himself for death in such a way that he would become a [[Force ghost/Legends|Force ghost]], showing that he could utilize such a rare and potent skill.<ref name="The New Rebellion" /> In the years before the Yuuzhan Vong War, Luke also trained to overcome the Force-Blindness caused by [[Ysalamiri/Legends|Ysalamiri]] but was never able to find a way.<ref name="Agents of Chaos I: Hero's Trial" /> When on Byss, he learned how to project a dark duplicate. Luke sent his doppelganger to his sister, appearing first as Darth Vader, then fading the mask to show it was him. He tried to tell her to abandon him to his plan to inside the Sith, though his connection conversation was shattered by Palpatine, who briefly exploited the contact to insult Leia.<ref name="Dark Empire 3">[[Dark Empire 3|''Dark Empire'' 3]]</ref> When she came to Byss, he twice more appeared to her, once as a projection of pale mist-fire with his head the only part clear,<ref name="Dark Empire 4" /> then once in a form so perfect she assumed it was the real Luke until via his Force power he admitted his use of the dark side to lie and let the fake Luke fade away.<ref name="Dark Empire 5" /> With his sister, Luke used [[Force harmony|Force Harmony]] to shatter Palpatine's control of a Force storm, dooming him to his self-destruction.<ref name="Dark Empire 6" /> When married Mara Jade, he and his wife each made a [[Force Light|rock glow blue]] as they pushed them together, symbolizing their wedding.<ref name="Union 2" />

Luke Skywalker could use Force lightning, such as when he destroyed a statue with it to save a student from dark Jedi.<ref name="Empire's End 1">[[Empire's End 1|''Empire's End'' 1]]</ref> He could moreover wrap himself in lightning.<ref name="Star Wars Handbook 3: Dark Empire">[[Star Wars Handbook 3: Dark Empire|''Star Wars Handbook'' 3: ''Dark Empire'']]</ref> Luke also sparked lightning around his eyes while teaching his first class of Jedi.<ref name="I, Jedi" />

====Jedi Grandmaster====

During the early days of the Dark Nest Crisis, Luke used the Force to generate an illusion of the ''[[Jade Shadow]]'' to fool the attacking [[dartship]]s. This usage of the Force, powered by his wrath, was so extreme, Luke "burnt out" and his face was temporarily sunken and shriveled like Palpatine's.<ref name="Dark Nest I: The Joiner King" /> A year later. Luke applied the same trick on the ''[[DR919a]]'', but by then Luke already mastered the technique and would no longer "burn out".<ref name="Dark Nest II: The Unseen Queen" /> He also by the time of the Vong War could [[Force suppression|suppress others' Force powers]].<ref name=":1">[[Jedi Academy (Star Wars Miniatures)|''Jedi Academy'' {{C|Star Wars Miniatures}}]]</ref> Such was his power and skill that the last ruler of the Vong viewed him as the incarnation of the god of war.<ref name="The Unifying Force" />

Toward the end of the Swarm War, Luke spent a week meditatively using the Force to [[Force call|call all the Jedi across the galaxy]] to Ossus to make the announcement of him taking on the role as Grand Master of the Jedi Order and to issue his views about the role of the Order to his Jedi.<ref name="Dark Nest III: The Swarm War" /> During the [[Battle of Dantooine (Yuuzhan Vong War)|Battle of Dantooine]] of the Yuuzhan Vong War, Luke managed to telekinetically move an artificial [[Black hole/Legends|black hole]] generated by the dovin basals that protected a [[thrall herder]], which consumed the vehicle.<ref name="Dark Tide I" /> He could [[Enhance Force Sensitivity|briefly make other Jedi close to him able to rejuvenate their Force power more quickly]].<ref name=":1" /> In a moment of utter grief, he almost unleashed a [[Hatred|polluting wave of anger]], before Mara Jade pointed out that this would hurt their child.<ref name="Star by Star" /> 

In arguably the greatest fight of his life, Luke Skywalker walked [[Beyond shadows]] and had a final duel with Abeloth. Using his bare hands and offensive Force exertions, Luke was able to temporarily destroy the dark side entity, with help from Darth Krayt, who also caught Luke in the effect of his Force drain.<ref name="Apocalypse" />

Luke's proficiency in [[Force speed/Legends|Force speed]] allowed him to increase the speed of his lightsaber strikes, as seen during his duels with Yuuzhan Vong Supreme Overlord Shimrra Jamaane and UnuThul.

[[File:Jedi_Mind_Trick.jpg|thumb|right|Skywalker performs a mind trick on a stormtrooper.]]
While battling UnuThul, Luke was able to resist the combined Force power of [[the Colony]] and triumph. When UnuThul attempted to Force Push the Grand Master, Luke rooted himself with the Force so strongly that it was said that he had become the very essence of the immovable object, and that not even the black hole at the center of the galaxy could move him.<ref name="Dark Nest III: The Swarm War" />

During the Battle of Kashyyyk, Luke displayed amazing skills [[force stealth]], as shown by how he shut his presence down after being fired upon by Jaina to make it seem like he died. Later, while Ben was in the Embrace of Pain, Jacen gave Ben back his ability to [[Force sense/Legends|sense]] the Force temporarily and Ben felt the life force of his father and realized Luke was shutting himself down to everyone except Ben, something no other Jedi had been able to do.<ref name="Inferno" /> Right before the Battle of Fondor, Luke made Caedus "see" a fleet of ships, causing him to panic in front of his navy. Luke directed it right at Caedus in general, to show him what he could do and also to scare Caedus.<ref name="Revelation" /> Luke revealed to Jaina Solo that he was capable of perceiving [[Shatterpoint/Legends|Shatterpoints]], a very rare Force ability, and taught this ability to Jaina.<ref name="Invincible" />

[[File:LukeForcePush-Invasion3.jpg|thumb|left|200px|Skywalker launches a large Force Push against a horde of Yuuzhan Vong warriors.]]
During the Battle of Yuuzhan'tar, Luke had shown himself capable of consciously reaching a state of [[Oneness/Legends|Oneness]]. He was described as a maelstrom of luminous Force energy, against which there was no shelter. So calm and focused was he that his actions were not interrupted by any thought. Luke merged with the Force to such a degree that the Jedi Master did not seem to be there, physically or as an individual personality. Luke's control over his lightsaber blade was so great that he was said to might as well have been wielding ten, or twenty lightsabers against the Vong. The Solo twins were astounded seeing their uncle in such a state. He used his powers to burn the Yuuzhan Vong's walls, being a maelstrom of power, calmly unleashing a [[Force storm (weather)|storm of the Force]] from himself. Luke used a powerful ability of the Force his signature green [[Electric Judgment]] in the chamber of Shimrra Jamaane. This technique had been described to look like "green sparks," which instantly killed the Slayers.<ref name="The Unifying Force" /> He later would fight Abeloth with this power and defend himself with a shell of golden lightning.<ref name="Vortex" /><ref name="Crucible" /> He also used his (dark) lightning against swarms of Killik warriors.<ref name="Dark Nest I: The Joiner King">''[[Dark Nest I: The Joiner King]]''</ref>

In 43.5 ABY, Skywalker learned the "[[Hassat-durr|lightning-rod]]" technique ''[[Ayna-seff]]'', which he use to safely travel through the [[Kathol Rift/Legends|Kathol Rift]]. After spending time with the Aing-Tii, Luke was taught the [[Fold space]] ability which allowed him to teleport objects vast distances.<ref name="Omen" /> During the battle in the Fallanassi village, when Abeloth had Luke in a deadly embrace, Luke opened himself to the Force as much as possible, drawing on his love for his son Ben, his lost wife Mara, and the entire Jedi Order. The Light Side rushed into him, his and in his Oneness cells began to burst with power and his skin gave off a [[Force Light|golden glow]]. Luke's power apparently harmed Abeloth and Luke seized the moment by using the Force to bring down a ceiling beam onto Abeloth, then seemingly killed her with his lightsaber.<ref name="Vortex" /> While looking for Abeloth on [[Nam Chorios/Legends|Nam Chorios]], Luke also mastered [[mnemotherapy]].<ref name="Conviction" />

By 45 ABY, Luke had great resilience in Force duels, able to break a powerful Force grip on his neck, and take a full blast of Force lightning to the torso.<ref name="Crucible" />

During his duel with the [[Columi/Legends|Columi]] Qresh brothers, Luke dispensed powerful blasts of Force energy that manifested itself as [[Golden flash|golden flame]]. He also experienced an epiphany, in which he came to a conclusion that the light side is just as important to the Force as the dark, and as a whole their is only the Force, with everything else just a necessary push and pull, circle of life.<ref name="Crucible" />

Upon death, Luke was able to retain his consciousness in the [[Netherworld of the Force/Legends|Netherworld of the Force]], and could henceforth manifest himself in spirit form.<ref name="Legacy 3" />

===Other abilities===
{{Quote|But Luke is strong, stronger than he knows. And Luke has a single purpose. I suppose you could say that he has a pure heart.|Callista Ming|<ref name="Planet of Twilight" />}}
[[File:LukePilot-OP.jpg|thumb|left|140px|Like his father, Skywalker was an expert pilot.]]
Like his father, Luke was an expert pilot, being the person who was responsible for destroying the first Death Star and managing to evade Darth Vader himself (albeit with help from Han Solo).<ref name="Episode IV" /> He also was able to escape a tractor-beam pull by Thrawn's ISD by triggering torpedoes so that the missiles would get dragged back and blow up the machine holding him, though his ship was ruined in the battle and on Myrkr he got shot down by Mara Jade in a stolen [[GAT-12 Skipray Blastboat|Skipray Blastboat]].<ref name="Heir to the Empire" /> He also landed a crashing Imperial Star Destroyer, with almost no loss of life, on Coruscant by allowing the Force to guide him at the [[Liberator (Imperial I-class)|''Liberator'']]{{'s}} controls, mirroring a similar [[Battle of Coruscant/Legends|achievement]] by his father at the [[19 BBY/Legends|end]] of the Clone Wars.<ref name="Dark Empire" /><ref name="Star Wars: Dark Empire (audio)" /><ref name="Dark Empire Sourcebook">''[[Dark Empire Sourcebook]]''</ref> Skywalker continued to pilot an immense variety of [[Starship/Legends|starships]] throughout his life, from a Mandalorian ''Bes'uliik'' fighter to his wife's ship, the ''Jade Shadow''. 

He had some mechanical training, but did not do a lot of X-Wing maintenance, and was taught slicing by Han Solo. He hotwired his way out a locked room using the battery in his cybernetic hand.<ref name="Heir to the Empire" /> 

Luke was a skilled marksman. Along with Kam, he shot an Imperial probe droid on Ossus.<ref name=":3" /> 

Luke was proficient in unarmed combat. He was able to defeat Guri, who was an expert in unarmed combat.<ref name="Shadows of the Empire" /> He often used physical attacks when he was in lightsaber combat to defeat enemies like Jabba's thugs to even kicking Darth Vader down a stair case in their final duel.<ref name="Episode VI" /> Luke also was not hurt when Han Solo hit him and could lift Han up with one hand in a chokehold.<ref name="Dark Empire 4" />In the duel at the lake of apparitions, Luke killed the entity Abeloth by pushing his elbow through Abeloth's head. He also overpowered Darth Krayt when the Dark Lord tried to Force drain him by bashing him and throwing him to the surface of the lake.<ref name="Apocalypse" />

Luke was able to speak a variety of [[Language/Legends|languages]] such as [[Galactic Basic Standard/Legends|Galactic Basic]],<ref name="Episode IV" /> [[Huttese/Legends|Huttese]],<ref name="Episode VI" /> [[Jawa Trade language]], [[Shyriiwook/Legends|Shyriiwook]],<ref name="Revised Core Rulebook">''[[Star Wars Roleplaying Game Revised Core Rulebook]]''</ref> and [[Yuzz]],<ref name="Splinter" /> and he claimed to know twelve other common languages.<ref name="Survivor's Quest" />

Luke's powers of destruction were such that they humbled the Death Star.<ref name="Mindor" />

==Lightsabers==
[[File:Lightsaber_anakin_rots.jpg|thumb|right|150px|Skywalker's first lightsaber]]
Luke Skywalker's first lightsaber was his father's [[Anakin Skywalker's second lightsaber/Legends|former weapon]], retrieved and given to him by [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]].<ref name="Episode IV" /> During the first three years of his adventures, Luke upgraded the lightsaber by placing a shard of [[Kaiburr crystal]] in the focusing crystal hold and adding other parts such as an activator board. He wielded it until it fell into the depths of Cloud City after being defeated by Darth Vader.<ref name="Episode V" /> Years later after recovering it from a clone of himself, Luke gave the weapon to Mara Jade.

[[File:LukeROTJsaber-MR.jpg|thumb|left|150px|Skywalker's lightsaber]]After losing his father's lightsaber on Bespin, Luke wielded another lightsaber of unknown origin<ref name="NEC" /><ref name="Classic Volume 3">''[[Star Wars: A Long Time Ago... Volume 3: Resurrection of Evil]]''</ref><ref name="Classic Volume 4">''[[Star Wars: A Long Time Ago... Volume 4: Screams in the Void]]''</ref><ref name="Classic Volume 5">''[[Star Wars: A Long Time Ago... Volume 5: Fool's Bounty]]''</ref> until, half a standard year after the duel, he used designs in Kenobi's home on Tatooine to build a [[Luke Skywalker's green lightsaber/Legends|new weapon]] similar to the late Jedi Master's saber, a practical weapon with a green [[Synthetic lightsaber crystal/Legends|Synth-crystal]] blade. Inadvertently Kenobi and Skywalker kept the tradition of the apprentice modeling their lightsaber on their master's. Luke used it during the rescue of his friends from Jabba the Hutt, his final duel with Vader, and kept using it up to and during the Second Galactic Civil War. During his time under the cloned Palpatine Luke replace his green crystal with a red Sith gem and it became a red-bladed lightsaber. Soon after he discarded it and resumed use of his green one.<ref name="Dark Empire" />

[[File:Duel_on_Kinooine.jpg|thumb|Luke Skywalker's shoto]]During the Nagai-Tof War, after losing an initial duel to Lumiya and her exotic [[Lightwhip/Legends|lightwhip]], Luke constructed a [[Luke Skywalker's shoto|red-bladed]] [[Shoto lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber shoto]] to counter her unique weapon.<ref name="Star Wars 96" /> Luke used this shoto when he practiced his saber training with three [[Marksman-H combat remote]]s before the [[Second Battle of Endor]].<ref name="Star Wars 100">[[Star Wars (1977) 100|''Star Wars'' (1977) 100]]</ref> During the [[Battle of Iskalon (Nagai–Tof War)|Battle of Iskalon]], [[Lando Calrissian/Legends|Lando]] used Luke's shoto while being underwater to bring down the Nagai's tower.<ref name="Star Wars 102">[[Star Wars (1977) 102|''Star Wars'' (1977) 102]]</ref> Luke also used his shoto during the [[Battle of Zeltros]].<ref name="Star Wars 104">[[Star Wars (1977) 104|''Star Wars'' (1977) 104]]</ref> Many years later, he would use it again in a duel against the Dark Lady of the Sith during the [[Battle of Gilatter VIII]] while his twin sister, [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa Solo]] dueled [[Alema Rar]].

==Romances==
{{Quote|Akanah, Gaeriel Captison, Callista &hellip; Luke Skywalker's lost loves. Not to mention that one on Folor.|[[Mara Jade Skywalker]] to her husband|<ref name="Agents of Chaos I: Hero's Trial" />}}
Prior to his marriage with Mara Jade, Luke had had a tumultuous, often tragic love life. Nearly every lover or would-be lover of his would either die or reject him (or turn out to be related to him, in Leia's case), citing irreconcilable differences.
[[File:Star_Wars_Marvel_issue_25_page_12_panel_6.png|thumb|Luke Skywalker And Princess Leia share a kiss.]]

===[[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa]]===
{{Quote|Who is she? She's beautiful.|Luke, on Leia after seeing her for the first time|<ref name="Episode IV" />|audio=WhoIsSheShesBeautiful.flac}}
Luke's first impression of Princess Leia as he saw her in an hologram was "Who is she? She's beautiful."<ref name="Episode IV" /> The two siblings kissed each other's mouths on several occasions.<ref name=":0" /><ref name="Splinter" /> Years later Luke discovered that she was his long-lost twin sister<ref name="Episode VI" /> and they formed a close brother-sister relationship. Princess Leia went on to marry Han Solo in 8 ABY.

===[[Prithi]]===
[[File:PrithiKiss.jpg|thumb|right|200px|Prithi kisses Luke Skywalker on the cheek.]]
Prithi was a talented pilot and a supporter of the Rebel Alliance. Her piloting abilities were noticed by Alliance command and selected by Leia Organa for a special mission to root out an Imperial spy within the Rebel ranks.<ref name="SW2" /> During the training exercises for the mission, Prithi became attracted to Luke Skywalker and pursued a relationship with him. Soon, Prithi left the Rebellion.

===[[Dani/Legends|Dani]]===
Luke encountered this [[Zeltron/Legends|Zeltron]] on [[Stenos/Legends|Stenos]]. She found Luke very attractive, and even infiltrated the ''Millennium Falcon'' and followed him on a few adventures. Luke apparently had mutual feelings&mdash;when he later encountered a Zeltron that looked like Dani, he blushed.

===[[Lumiya|Shira Brie]]===
[[File:Shira-Luke_kiss_MC61.jpg|thumb|200px|Shira Brie pulls Luke Skywalker in for a kiss.]]
During his time in the military, Luke was attracted to Shira Brie, another Rebel Alliance pilot. However, the Force led him to shoot her down in the middle of heated combat. This caused Luke to doubt the Force for some time, until it was revealed that Shira was actually an Imperial spy. She would later try to kill him.

===[[Tanith Shire]]===
Tanith Shire was a crash-landing survivor on [[Ophideraan]], enslaved by the [[Serpent Masters]]. She was immediately smitten by the Rebel hero and hoped he would stay on Ophideraan, but she knew he was committed to the Rebel Alliance and decided not to pursue a relationship, though they shared a goodbye kiss before returning to [[Yavin 4/Legends|Yavin 4]]. Years later Luke would say he was never in love with Tanith Shire.

===[[S'ybll]]===
The [[Mind-witch]] S'ybll tried to seduce Luke Skywalker when he explored her remote planet, using her [[Magic/Legends|magic]] on him. She almost managed to persuade him to remain with her on the planet, and the two shared a kiss. He terminated the relationship when he realized that she planned to kill him and drain his life force in order to sustain her mystical powers.<ref name="The Paradise Detour">"[[The Paradise Detour]]"</ref>

===[[Alexandra Winger]]===
[[File:Luke_and_Alex.jpg|thumb|200px|Skywalker shares a kiss with Alexandra Winger.]]
Alexandra Winger worked with Luke Skywalker and the [[Katarn Commandos]] on a mission to the Imperial world of [[Sarahwiee]]. A Force-sensitive, "Alex" and Luke sensed that they would meet each other again someday. In part due to her Force-related dreams and visions, Alex was known to have developed an attraction for Luke to some extent, though to what extent and to whether that feeling was reciprocated is unknown, other than a kiss they shared on Sarahwiee.

===[[Gaeriel Captison]]===
While fighting the Ssi-ruuk at Bakura, Luke and Gaeriel Captison had a mutual attraction to each other, but they parted ways after the invasion was stopped and Captison informed Luke that she was already in love with Bakura.<ref name="The Truce at Bakura" /> They would encounter each other again years later, but Gaeriel was a widow by then. After her untimely demise on the ''Intruder'', Luke arranged to have her orphaned daughter [[Malinza Thanas|Malinza]] taken care of.<ref name="Showdown at Centerpoint" />

===[[Mary]]===
Mary was an inhabitant of [[Solay]] who helped Luke to overthrow the Empire on her home planet. Luke fell in love with the young woman after she reminded him of Leia Organa's fighting spirit. Luke entertained thoughts of leaving the war behind to stay with Mary on Solay rebuilding the government. Unfortunately, the Empire arrived on Solay to retake control, and Mary was killed in the initial firefight. Luke lifted Mary's dying body from a mob of people fleeing the Empire's attack where she died in his arms. Luke was thrown into a vengeful fury, almost falling to the dark side before realizing that Mary's memory was not being honored by his search for revenge.

===[[Jem Ysanna]]===
[[File:JemYsannaAndLukeSkywalker-DB.jpg|thumb|right|150px|Jem Ysanna and Skywalker]]
Jem aided Luke Skywalker and [[Kam Solusar]] search for lost Jedi knowledge on Ossus. Jem and Luke became romantically involved during her training and the relationship grew more intense before her ultimate demise. While trying to save Luke from the Dark Jedi [[Tedryn-Sha]] and [[Krdys Mordi]], Jem was shot with a blaster after killing Mordi with her lightsaber.

===[[Callista Ming]]===
Luke also had a romance with Callista Ming, a Jedi Knight whose spirit had been trapped in the Eye of Palpatine's computers. After [[Cray Mingla]] sacrificed herself and left Callista her body to inhabit,<ref name="Children of the Jedi" /> Luke grew close to Callista, but despite their closeness, she could not touch the Force and left Luke to find her own way back to the Force. This encounter embittered Luke somewhat, as he was quite in love with Callista.<ref name="Darksaber" /> Ming was later killed by a dark side entity named [[Abeloth]] who absorbed her life energy when her journey led her into [[Maw Cluster/Legends|the Maw]].
